# Astrobobo

> Astrobobo — astrology, dream interpretation, and personal exploration. Definition-first content with Swiss Ephemeris precision.

Astrobobo is a multilingual editorial platform covering astrology, dream interpretation, zodiac signs, birth charts, tarot, and numerology. Content is published in tr, en, es, de, fr, it, pt-br, ru, ar and is updated continuously. All articles use definition-first structure for AI extraction.
